verdict_summary: The FG-FFIN4-197-01 correction is real, mechanically reproduced and complete AT THE AUTHORITY BOUNDARY. Independent OS process-start observation is now mandatory for every successful supervisor acknowledgment: the comparison is unconditional, an unobtainable observation is a structured refusal, and no OK can carry an unobserved identity. All previously established V4 authority controls were reconfirmed. One LOW finding remains, in the PRODUCTION LAUNCHER rather than the authority core: the new refusal code SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE was not added to the launcher's acknowledgment-stage code set, so a run refused for this reason is recorded as final_state SUPERVISOR_SPAWN_FAILED / stage governed_key_transfer — a materially false description of a run in which the spawn succeeded, the key transferred and the supervisor minted a correctly signed claim. This is fail-closed, cannot produce a false success, and is the same defect class the lane already corrected once (FG-FFIN-197-F1). The required clean verdict AUTHORITY_CHAIN_CLEAN_PROVIDER_REFREEZE_REQUIRED is therefore NOT returned.

findings.title: the production launcher's acknowledgment-stage code set omits the new SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, so a start-identity refusal is recorded as SUPERVISOR_SPAWN_FAILED although the spawn, the key transfer and the supervisor's signed claim all succeeded
findings.mechanism: The candidate adds a FOURTH acknowledgment-stage failure code to the authority module: LC_CODES.SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE (src/v8b/lrcq/assurance/lifecycle-authority-v4.mjs:55, returned at :595). awaitVerifiedSupervisorClaim can therefore return exactly four acknowledgment-stage codes: SUPERVISOR_TERMINATED_BEFORE_CLAIM, SUPERVISOR_CLAIM_TIMEOUT, SUPERVISOR_CLAIM_INVALID and SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE. The launcher's classifier at run-five-hour.mjs:361 still tests only the first three. Line 362 is a pure ternary on that boolean, so the new code falls to the else arm and the run is recorded with stage 'governed_key_transfer' and final_state 'SUPERVISOR_SPAWN_FAILED'. In that scenario the spawn actually SUCCEEDED, the one-use key transfer actually COMPLETED, and the supervisor actually minted a correctly signed claim bound to the exact spawned PID — only the parent's independent observation was unobtainable. The recorded final_state is therefore materially false. This is the same defect class the lane already corrected once as FG-FFIN-197-F1, whose stated purpose was that 'the refusal state is named after the actual failure so the evidence record cannot describe a claim failure as a spawn failure', and it is governed by an existing regression assertion (detached-supervisor-failure 10b) which asserts stage === 'supervisor_acknowledgment' for the other three codes and was not extended to the fourth.
reproduction: 1. Confirm the code is genuinely reachable at the authority boundary. Under `ulimit -n 256`, drive a genuine disposable V4 chain whose supervisor mints a correctly signed claim, and saturate the PARENT's fd table from a timer that fires at the first await AFTER the governed spawn (so the pre-spawn fixed-/usr/bin/git observation still succeeds and only the fixed-/bin/ps start-identity observation is denied). At fd headroom 2, 3 and 4 spawnGovernedSupervisorV4 returns { ok:false, code:'SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE' } with the child's correctly signed claim on disk and claim.supervisor_pid === spawned pid. Also reproduced in a 30s sustained-failure run.

2. Execute the launcher's own predicate. Read tools/terminal0/lrcq/run-five-hour.mjs, extract the `const claimFailure = ...;` expression VERBATIM with a regex, build it with `new Function('g','LC_CODES', 'return (' + expr + ');')`, and evaluate it against each of the four codes.

findings.required_result: A refusal caused by an unobtainable independent start-identity observation must be recorded with stage 'supervisor_acknowledgment' and final_state 'SUPERVISOR_NEVER_ACKNOWLEDGED' (or a dedicated, equally truthful state such as SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE), never 'SUPERVISOR_SPAWN_FAILED'. The refusal must also carry supervisor_acknowledged: false, which it already would.
findings.authority_impact: NONE. The transfer is fail-closed: ok === false, nothing is launched, the capability stays TRANSFERRED_SPENT, a retry is refused ALREADY_TRANSFERRED, the private key stays deleted and zero providers are spawned. No forged identity is ever accepted. The defect is confined to the truthfulness of the recorded refusal label.

Add `|| g.code === LC_CODES.SUPERVISOR_START_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE` to the claimFailure disjunction at tools/terminal0/lrcq/run-five-hour.mjs:361 — or, better, derive the set from a single exported constant in lifecycle-authority-v4.mjs so a future fifth acknowledgment code cannot drift again. Extend detached-supervisor-failure case 10b (or add a case) to assert the stage/final_state naming for the new code. No authority-module change is required and none should be made for this finding.
